        * {

        :root {
          --text-strong: #0d0d0d; /* gray-900 */

        }
        
        :root[data-theme="dark"] {
          color-scheme: dark;
          --text-strong: #fff;
          --text-primary: #f0f0f0; /* gray-50 */

        }
        
        body {
